subject.title: Android onboarding can loop after permission reapproval

question: Which open Android onboarding fix should remain the canonical landing path for this issue?
rationale: The issue has a protected maintainer label and two open same-bug fix PRs, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100959 explicitly closing this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100760 predating it.

options.title: Use the closing PR as canonical
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100959, then close or supersede the older same-bug PR.

options.title: Revive the older PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100760 instead if maintainers prefer its state-machine shape and proof history.

options.title: Reject both branches
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a different Android onboarding fix if neither branch matches the desired implementation direction.

recommendation.title: Use the closing PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100959, then close or supersede the older same-bug PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live issue assignee and author of both open same-bug fix PRs.
